=={{header|Ada}}==
The interface package Exported specification:
<syntaxhighlight lang="ada">with Interfaces.C;          use Interfaces.C;
with Interfaces.C.Strings;  use Interfaces.C.Strings;

package Exported is
   function Query (Data : chars_ptr; Size : access size_t)
      return int;
   pragma Export (C, Query, "Query");
end Exported;</syntaxhighlight>
The package implementation:
<syntaxhighlight lang="ada">package body Exported is
   function Query (Data : chars_ptr; Size : access size_t)
      return int is
      Result : char_array := "Here am I";
   begin
      if Size.all < Result'Length then
         return 0;
      else
         Update (Data, 0, Result);
         Size.all := Result'Length;
         return 1;
      end if;
   end Query;
end Exported;</syntaxhighlight>
With [[GNAT]] it can be built as follows:
<syntaxhighlight lang="ada">gcc -c main.c
gnatmake -c exported.adb
gnatbind -n exported.ali
gnatlink exported.ali main.o -o main</syntaxhighlight>
Sample output:
<pre>
Here am I
</pre>
